title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
version: 2026-06-01 non-European mathematics record: al-Battani through segment 50 plus Qin and Aryabhata repairs
description:
Dedicated record for non-European and multilingual mathematical manuscripts in the Modern LaTeX Editions project. It contains Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, and historical-reference mathematical works as modern-LaTeX reader PDFs, translation drafts, source files, and preservation artifacts.

Current public surface. [#######---] 59 individual work/language reader PDFs / 3095 pages. This update promotes al-Battani's Opus Astronomicum cumulative working reader through segments 1-50 and applies targeted repaired Qin Jiushao and Aryabhata readers, with TeX sources, compile reports, render evidence, and structured coverage data preserved in a separate artifact ZIP.

Status at a glance.

  • Work-level reader coverage: [#######---] broad current public surface, still working editions.
  • Source/provenance preservation: [##########] source bundles, OCR text, page images, audit notes, structured data, and broader drafts are retained in ZIP artifacts.
  • Polished critical-edition status: [----------] not yet proofread or certified.

The public organization is by work and language. The archive favors a clean reader surface while preserving provenance and repair material for continuation.
notes: Current non-European/multilingual record. Latest update promotes al-Battani Opus Astronomicum segments 1-50 and targeted Qin/Aryabhata replacements.
